name: app-lavender-payment-and-booking-confirmed-screens-with-brush-notes
title: Payment and Booking Confirmed with Brush Notes
whatItIs: A lavender page with a payment phone cropped at the top (pay-by-app icons, fee breakdown and a blue Pay button), a booking confirmed phone with a 3D plane and a summary card, and two brush-stroke white notes joined to the phones by elbow connector lines.
whatItMeans: Connectors from torn notes to the screens explain each step, and a 3D plane makes confirmation a celebration.
techniques: Torn paper notes linked by connector lines
3D plane icon as the confirmation reward
Payment app icons in rounded tiles
Blue gradient primary and grey secondary buttons

vocabulary.definition: A rough torn-paper shape holding an annotation.
A celebratory 3D illustration on a success screen.
A list showing room fee, discount, tax and total.
